nexindu.label: §1 · Case study
nexindu.title: NexIndu — AI-powered CMMS/EAM for regulated plants
nexindu.status: Status: pre-launch · Personal project, built in my own time ·
nexindu.problem: In a regulated plant, every maintenance task produces records that must be traceable, signed and searchable for years. A generic AI assistant doesn't fit that context: it doesn't cite where its answers come from, leaves no auditable trail and requires sending documentation to external services.

approach.v: Semantic search on pgvector with multilingual embeddings computed locally (ONNX, 384 dimensions).
About 40 intents are resolved deterministically; everything else goes to the LLM (Gemini), which answers with cited sources.
Electronic signatures with re-authentication and passkeys, an immutable hash-chained audit trail and soft deletes only.
Automated prompt evaluations, a fallback model, usage logging and a per-company AI budget.

rag.caption: Indexing runs locally: documents never leave the system to be embedded. The model only receives the chunks needed to answer, and every answer cites its source.

routing.aAction: Deterministic handling · direct data query, no LLM
routing.bAction: LLM (Gemini) + RAG · answers with cited sources
routing.bar: Usage logging · Per-company AI budget · Automated prompt evaluations
routing.caption: Predictable requests skip the LLM: faster, cheaper and always reproducible. The LLM is reserved for what actually needs language.
